notes.title: Sheeple Shops
notes.content:
[h1]Hello There, Sheeple![/h1]

[h3]In Sheeple, there is a Shop system that allows players to buy new units![/h3]
There are 3 different shopkeepers, each with a different fraction of units they can sell. Each time you finish a battle, the amount of shopkeepers in the shop space is being randomised as well as: the shopkeepers themself, the units they are selling, and the terrain in the shop. To buy units in the shop, you need to have sheep which are later sacrificed to the shopkeepers as payment. To gain sheep, you need to finish a battle with spare skulls. After each battle, all your skulls are converted into sheep at a ratio of 130 skulls to one sheep.
[h3]Green Shop[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341705/7e193f884a772185540a093ce3a2e72d0f73f099.png[/img]

[h3][i]Have a fruitful day!
Leon[/i][/h3]
